Image.summary: Image button that draws a texture and fires OnClick when clicked, reusing Button's pressed state

props.padding: Inner padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels, default {0,0,0,0}
props.color: Texture tint {r,g,b,a}, default {1,1,1,1}, multiplied in via gl.Color before drawing
props.file: Foreground texture file name, nil means not drawn; drawn after file2 when both are set
props.file2: Background/underlying texture file name, nil means not drawn; drawn before file
props.flip: Flip the file texture vertically (flipy), default true
props.flip2: Flip the file2 texture vertically, default true
props.keepAspect: Keep the texture aspect ratio (scale uniformly and center), default true; false stretches it to fill the control
props.noFont: Skip automatic creation of the default font object, default true (images rarely need text)
props.OnClick: Click callback table (array); the control is only interactive when it is non-empty (see IsActive)

Image:DrawControl.desc: Draw the file2 and file textures tinted by color; keepAspect centers them uniformly, otherwise they are stretched to fill, then texture unit 0 is unbound

Image:IsActive.desc: Whether the control is interactive: true when OnClick[1] exists, otherwise nil

Image:HitTest.desc: Hit test: returns self when IsActive, otherwise nil (the source signature takes no arguments)

Image:MouseDown.desc: Hand the event to Control.MouseDown first; returns self when it was not handled and IsActive

Image:MouseUp.desc: Hand the event to Control.MouseUp first; returns self when it was not handled and IsActive

Image:MouseClick.desc: Hand the event to Control.MouseClick first; returns self when it was not handled and IsActive, so OnClick fires

fileDesc: Defines the Image class (inherits Button): draws file/file2 textures with aspect keeping, vertical flipping and OnClick support.
